scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Stipulated fail-safe float-up configuration and failure boundary
entries.units: kg; m3; kg/m3; m MSL; N; s
entries.method: Request complete matched loaded/empty article mass and displacement, atmosphere and inventory records with a defined loss of rotor/electrical authority; record actual response history and uncertainty.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Assumed dry target and standard-atmosphere sketch are not a built hull. Unmatched weather, architecture, equipment inclusions or residual authority prevents transfer of the stipulated float-up property.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Half-load hull with two-way rotors and loaded loss of authority
entries.units: N signed; W; kg; m3; m/s; s
entries.method: Request identified bidirectional actuator/installation evidence, complete loaded state and failure event, observed control/rotor response and any water-release response tied to shared time and bus boundaries.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Reverse factor and article configuration are assumptions; drawn rotors are declared non-reversible. A different article or commanded shedding rate does not establish a loaded failure response or retain fail-safe float-up.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Airspeed-to-bag load hand-over and transient cable support
entries.existing_model_reference: payload-exchange.json classes.*.routes.c.handOver; Question 15 bag transfer question
entries.units: N; kg; m; m/s; angle rad; W; s
entries.method: Request synchronized airspeed, attitude, cable geometry/tension, bag inventory/motion and pickup/release state with rotor/control/bus response and attachment identity through the transition.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A moving-leg downforce result cannot fill a stopped transfer interval. Ground-tethered precedent, quasi-static bag credit or unmatched bag motion does not establish this hull transition.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Variable displacement versus permanently sealed-cell architecture
entries.units: m3; Pa; kg; W; Wh; s
entries.method: Request explicit matching architecture and authorized design-decision provenance before any future displacement/pressure/actuation record; retain cell integrity, complete installation and response evidence on the same article.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The existing route is closed by the sealed-cell decision. A gas-compression analogue or ideal work sketch does not demonstrate sealed vacuum-cell volume change; no decision is reopened here.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Cryogenic ballast production within the available phase and installation
entries.units: kg; kg/s; W; Wh/kg; K; Pa; s
entries.method: Request matched plant/tank/support mass, feed/product states, startup/cold readiness, measured net throughput, retention and power histories over the same named phase/window, including failed starts and outages.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Historical specific energies, plant ratings and sketch windows do not establish airborne production. Missing cooling, standby, retention or installation inclusions invalidates direct transfer; no required power or mass is recalculated.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Published signed-unheld failure requirements and actual motion evidence
entries.units: N signed; coordinate identity; m/s; m/s2; kg; timestamp; s
entries.method: Request matched configuration, basis, atmosphere, phase/seam timing, simultaneous force-owner observations and actual motion/controller history with raw provenance and uncertainty.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Model residual sign identifies required authority on prescribed controls. It is not measured acceleration or proof of strategy outcome; different sign convention, phase or controls prevents comparison.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Complete strategy-specific installation and evidence boundary
entries.existing_model_reference: payload-exchange.md What this study leaves out; docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md critical path
entries.units: kg; inclusion list; component identity; calibration identity; time basis
entries.method: Request itemized structure, actuator, cable/bag, tank, plant, battery, thermal/support and control inclusions with component identities and the source/measurement chain for each proposed configuration.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Unpriced inertia, cable/bag dynamics or mismatched mass/power boundaries cannot be filled by a sketch closure. No installation estimate or physical criterion is invented.
